title: Spicy Arabian Chicken Salad
description: A flavorful and refreshing salad inspired by the Middle Eastern cuisine, with spicy saudi chicken and crunchy lettuce.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together saudi chili powder and arabian ghee.
2. Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Remove chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing into thin strips.
6. In a large salad bowl, combine chopped lettuce and mixed greens.
7. Arrange the sliced chicken on top of the salad.
9. Serve immediately and garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
